subject: Coordination: platform onboarding demo + security checkpoint
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@globex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: platform onboarding demo + security checkpoint

Hi Sam — thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood as the inference runtime for Globex's pilot (platform + procurement runway).
- Primary success criteria you mentioned: sub-100ms 0.5k token latency for internal prompts, audited access logs, and SSO integration.

Proposed next steps (two short sessions):
1) 45-min Technical Deep Dive (prod-focused): demo of the runtime, deployment patterns, and quantization trade-offs — invite your platform engineering lead.
2) 30-min Security & Procurement Checkpoint: SSO/KMS requirements + procurement timeline — invite procurement and security stakeholders.

Availability (PST) — pick one per session:
- Week of Oct 11: Tue 10:00-11:00 or Thu 14:00-15:00
- Week of Oct 18: Wed 09:00-10:00 or Fri 13:00-14:00

I’m looping in Marissa from Solutions (cc) to coordinate logistics and Aisha from Security Ops for any evidence needs — Aisha, can you advise if we should pre-send SOC2 artifacts or an environment diagram before the security checkpoint?

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, deployment-patterns.png (deployment pattern examples); I’ll also share a short SSO checklist if helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@globex.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Procure <lauren.procurement@globex.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coordination: platform onboarding demo + security checkpoint

Thanks Jasmine — that recap is spot on. We’d like to proceed with both sessions but with two asks: 

1) Please include an SSO/SSO-anything technical owner from your side who can speak to SAML/OIDC options and our internal IdP mapping.
2) Loop in procurement early — I’ve cc’d Lauren (procurement) to make sure we can surface preliminary pricing & contract milestones during the procurement checkpoint.

Our initial availability (ET):
- Week of Oct 11: Tue 13:00-14:00 ET (works for platform deep dive)
- Week of Oct 18: Thu 15:00-15:30 ET (shorter, but we can do security checkpoint)

Also: our platform lead (Priya Nambiar) is on PTO Oct 13–17; can we avoid that week for the deep dive? Priya’s email is priya@acme-inc.com (she’s external — contractor embedded on the Globex team).

If you can send a 1-pager for security evidence we can pre-scan it; Lauren, do you need any procurement docs up front?

—Sam
Head of Data Platforms | Globex Corporation

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@globex.com>, Priya Nambiar <priya@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Procure <lauren.procurement@globex.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: platform onboarding demo + security checkpoint

Great — thanks for the availability and the heads-up on Priya’s PTO. Confirming approach: 

- Technical Deep Dive (45m) — Tue Oct 11, 16:00-16:45 UTC (which is Tue 12:00 PT / 15:00 ET) — will that map to Sam’s Tue 13:00-14:00 ET note? If not, propose Wed Oct 12 16:00 UTC as fallback.
- Security & Procurement Checkpoint (30m) — Thu Oct 21, 15:00-15:30 ET (to keep it after Priya returns).

Deliverables we’ll share before the sessions:
- SSO and network requirements (mvp-sso-checklist.xlsx)
- SOC2 evidence catalog and retention summary (PDF excerpts)
- Example deployment diagram (deployment-patterns.png)

Aisha: I’ve assigned a short pre-read — can you confirm if the SOC2 excerpts + the SSO checklist are sufficient for Globex’s initial review or if they want additional logs/audit examples?

Marissa will send calendar invites and an agenda — Marissa, please include an optional pre-call 15-min sync for the Globex platform engineer if they want to align on test data and workspace access.

Thanks everyone — I’ll mark the sessions as tentative until Lauren confirms procurement attendance.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mvp-sso-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@globex.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Priya Nambiar <priya@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Procure <lauren.procurement@globex.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: platform onboarding demo + security checkpoint

Hi all — sending confirmed invites: 

1) Technical Deep Dive — Tue Oct 12, 2027 @ 16:00 UTC / 12:00 PT / 15:00 ET (45m) — Calendar invite sent to attendees. Agenda: 10m walkthrough, 20m live demo + 10m Q&A.
2) Security & Procurement Checkpoint — Thu Oct 21, 2027 @ 15:00 ET (30m) — invite sent to procurement and security. Agenda: contract milestones, SSO mapping, evidence handoff.

Notes / ask: 
- Sam / Priya: please add any internal attachments (network allowlist, test dataset policy) to the Drive folder prior to Oct 11. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/GLX-2027-089
- Lauren: if procurement would like a preliminary MSA or pricing worksheet, I can attach a draft to the security invite — let me know preferred format (PDF vs Docx).

Looking forward — will reopen thread if logistics change.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Calendar invites attached]
